metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Relevant annotated passages retrieved divided by all relevant annotated passages.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_k: Reciprocal rank of the first relevant passage, or zero when absent.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: Normalized DCG using annotated relevance grades and gain 2^grade - 1.
metric_definitions.top1_accuracy: Fraction of questions with a relevant passage at rank one.
metric_definitions.latency: Warm search wall time; model initialization and indexing excluded.
